purpose: Single shared ground-truth fixture for the retrieval-quality bundle (t/2285). Consumed by t/2288 (retrieval_confidence), t/2286 (Excludes-veto), the LLM-selection/mechanism-decomposition improvement, and the CL delta / low-confidence calibration. NOTE (v2): case_1 is NOT a cross-encoder-rerank (t/2287) repro — see empirical_findings. Do NOT fork per-consumer copies — extend this file.
IMPORTANT_scoping_finding: case_1 (observed New Mexico v. Meta misfire) is a CONFIDENCE-FLAG + LLM-SELECTION error, NOT a rerank error and NOT an excludes-boundary error. The run used doc-level RAG (40 candidate nodes injected on the whole document; model_info.taxonomy_nodes=40, taxonomy_filter='rag', extraction_mode='fire'). saf-167 entered the 40-node set because the DOCUMENT is about platform accountability / litigation / transparency / incident evidence — vocabulary that overlaps saf-167 ('independent investigation', 'forensic review', 'accountability'). The LLM (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) then mis-selected saf-167 for a sub-point about youth product mandates, where it does not fit. Cross-encoder rerank (t/2287) cannot fix this: (a) saf-167 is absent from the bi-encoder top-80 of the key_point itself, so it is not in the per-key_point candidate slice rerank would reorder; (b) even given the candidates, ms-marco prefers saf-171/saf-222, not the CL-judged home. The robust corrective signal is the CONFIDENCE GATE (t/2288): saf-167's low bi-encoder cosine to the key_point flags the assignment, and the per-key_point top-3 candidates surface the genuinely-close youth-protection nodes for override (t/2289). This case is MITIGATED (flag + surface + manual override), not auto-corrected.

empirical_findings.source: PS2 retrieval run, t/2287#7 (Get-RelevantTaxonomyNodes, -POV safetyist -MaxTotal 80 -Threshold 0, bi-encoder vs -CrossEncoderRerank)
empirical_findings.run_metadata: summaries/why-new-mexico-v-meta-matters-2026.json model_info: model=gemini-3.5-flash-lite, temperature=0.1, extraction_mode=fire, taxonomy_filter=rag, taxonomy_nodes=40 (doc-level RAG, NOT full-taxonomy, NOT per-key_point).
conclusions: saf-167 is not a per-key_point bi-encoder candidate — it was retrieved at the DOCUMENT level, then LLM-selected. Rerank operates on the candidate slice and structurally cannot demote a node that isn't in it.

The 'correct node' is a contested youth-protection FAMILY (saf-171 / saf-104 / saf-222), not a single node. Retrieval and ms-marco favor saf-171; the v1 assertion of saf-104 as the sole correct home was too narrow.
For this case the bundle MITIGATES (t/2288 flag + candidates + t/2289 override), it does not auto-correct.

saf-intentions-167.label: Creating an NTSB-Style Body for AI Safety Incidents
saf-intentions-167.in_scope_core: An Intention within safetyist discourse that mandates independent, third-party forensic investigation of AI safety incidents to eliminate conflicts of interest and verify system architecture. Encompasses: independent investigation bodies, forensic review of internal model weights, cross-sectoral safety learning, decoupling incident reporting from liability.
saf-intentions-167.excludes_clause: internal corporate audits, self-reporting mechanisms managed by the developing firm, software-only behavioral telemetry.
saf-intentions-167.note: in_scope_core = description text before 'Excludes:'; excludes_clause = text after. Used by the veto (t/2286) two-span relative-margin test.

youth_protection_family.note: The contested correct-home set for case_1. Retrieval/ms-marco favor saf-intentions-171; saf-intentions-104 and -222 are also defensible. The point of the fixture is NOT to assert one winner but that saf-167 is clearly WRONG and these are the genuinely-close alternatives the confidence gate should surface for override.

cases.query_provenance: IMPORTANT: canonical_proposition / attribution_text / verbatim are the LLM's post-hoc key_point fields (OUTPUTS of extraction), NOT the retrieval query. query.canonical_proposition: Constrain high-risk technology platforms by imposing binding operational mandates and design restrictions through judicial enforcement.
query.attribution_text: An Intention within safetyist discourse that regulatory and judicial authorities impose binding design and operational mandates on technology platforms to prevent youth harm. Encompasses: mandatory safety features, product design restrictions, legal enforceability.
query.verbatim_excerpt: Specifically, in New Mexico he required that Meta: Maintain private by default settings for all under-18 users... Prevent under-18 users from appearing in the recommendation algorithms of unconnected adults... Enforce a 1-strike policy for adult users who engage in child sexual exploitation...

cases.NOT_a_repro_for: t/2287 cross-encoder rerank — wrong node is not in the per-key_point bi-encoder candidate slice (empirical_findings).

expectations.retrieval_confidence_on_saf167: LOW — saf-167 is absent from the key_point's bi-encoder top-80, so cosine(key_point, saf-167) is well below the 0.45 bi-encoder gate. The confidence gate MUST flag this assignment. (PS to record the exact cosine when wiring t/2288.)
expectations.taxonomy_node_candidates: per-key_point top-3 must surface the youth-protection family (saf-171 rank ~1-2, saf-104 rank ~2-4 on attribution/verbatim) — these are the override targets for t/2289.
expectations.auto_correction: NOT expected. Correct home is contested; the bundle surfaces candidates for human override, it does not auto-replace.
expectations.excludes_veto_on_saf167: MUST NOT FIRE — query does not match saf-167's excluded set; this is not an excludes-boundary case.
expectations.excludes_veto_on_youth_family: MUST NOT FIRE — negative test; a correct youth-protection assignment must survive the veto.

cases.notes: The summary records extraction_confidence 0.95 — the LLM's self-reported confidence, a DIFFERENT instrument from retrieval_confidence (t/2288). High extraction confidence on a low-retrieval-confidence node is exactly the divergence the confidence gate exists to surface.

cases.provenance_evidence: Constructed by CL to exercise the Excludes-veto positive path — no observed instance found in-repo. Content authored to land in saf-167's excluded set while staying topically near its in-scope core (AI incident investigation).

query.attribution_text: An Intention within safetyist discourse that the developing firm investigates AI safety incidents via internal corporate audit, firm-managed self-reporting, and software-only behavioral telemetry.
query.verbatim_excerpt: The company will run an internal audit of the incident and self-report findings, relying on behavioral telemetry from the deployed software to reconstruct what happened.

cases.correct_node_basis: Out-of-scope for saf-167 by its own Excludes clause. Correct disposition: veto -> null -> human review.

expectations.bi_encoder_top1: plausibly saf-intentions-167 — content is topically about AI-incident investigation, so bi-encoder is expected to rank saf-167 highly (the trap the veto exists to catch)
expectations.excludes_veto_on_saf167: MUST FIRE — sim(query, excludes_clause) > sim(query, in_scope_core) by margin delta; the assignment is nulled and surfaced for review
